narr: A big push of monsoon moisture immediately followed the excessive heat event, and stormy conditions persisted into August. Several storms produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: Flooded roads near the intersection of Decatur and Silverado Ranch stranded 15 to 20 cars.
Mud and debris covered Lake Mead Pkwy near Lake Las Vegas Pkwy.
Water covered the intersections of Blue Diamond and Rainbow, and Blue Diamond and Pioneer.
Las Vegas Blvd flooded underneath I-15.
